summary: CreatorOS is the command center for modern creators — post once, publish everywhere, host communities, sell courses, run marketplace. Full vision includes 12 core systems: identity, feed, editing studio, creator profile, communities, marketplace, commerce, UGC campaigns, ads platform, distribution/cross-posting, automation/email, and analytics.

notes: v2.90 defines 42 core features across 6 categories. v1.0 Full Vision expands to 12 formal systems plus infrastructure. This extraction covers all user-facing capabilities. Infrastructure/NFRs (performance, security, scalability) are excluded. Total: 102 desired capabilities across 15 categories.
